lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Survivalist.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I've been thinking

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: about doing a survival show.
A survival show?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: They used to be really popular back in the olden days.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: They're TV shows about how to survive in the wilderness.
Sounds fun.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: There's no such thing as untamed wilderness in the Ark,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: and hardly anyone living there has been up to the surface,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: so I'm sure a show like that would be a big hit.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I'm just not sure what the first episode should be about.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: There's just so much content to choose from.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I'm not sure where to start.
What about bizarre food sources found in the wild?
What about you versus wild animals?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Oh, that's a great idea!

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Let's see...

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: What would people find most fascinating:

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: The eyeballs or the heart of a dead animal?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Spiders and centipedes with their venom removed?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Then again, I don't really like creepy crawlies.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I mean, I'll choke them down if things get desperate,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: but I'm not gonna go out of my way to eat them.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Since there are some insects I don't mind, like grasshoppers.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Maybe I could show that.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I'd say the most dangerous of all the northern wildlife

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: would be the bear,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: so perhaps I should gear towards something like me versus one of them?
... You're planning on fighting a bear?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Of course not.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Do you realize how highly animals are valued in the Ark?

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I could handle it, but the viewers would turn against me in an instant.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: So, I'll just proceed as if I'm a regular human,

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: and just advise people on how to avoid bears altogether.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Or, if you encounter one, merely how to survive.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I think we've got a solid game plan for the first episode.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: The only thing left to do is put it into action!

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Unfortunately, we don't have any cameramen here at the Northern Base.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I'll have to stick my phone onto a selfie stick and secure that to my bag.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I wonder how the footage will come out.
I'm willing to bet it'll be awfully shaky.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Yeah... I guess that's not really feasible.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: I'll have to come up with something else

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: or wait for you to help me the next time you come by the base.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Still, I'll give the selfie stick thing a shot just to be sure.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: If the footage comes out decent, I'll show it to you.
Looking forward to seeing it.

lines.speaker: tove
lines.text: Hehe, I'll let you know.
